headline: Built on proven ground, <gold>engineered for returns</gold>
description: Our operation sits on the historic Lupa Goldfield in Chunya, Mbeya - one of Africa's most prolific mineral belts, with a track record stretching back to 1922.

cards.title: Gravity Concentration Technology
cards.description: Our chemical-free gravity process is environmentally compliant and cost-efficient, recovering gold without mercury or cyanide - fully NEMC certified.

cards.title: Fully Licensed Operations
cards.description: Active Primary Mining Licence (PML) and secured mining title. All regulatory approvals in place under Africa's Mining Act 2010 and subsequent amendments.

cards.title: Transparent Financial Model
cards.description: Monthly projections of $504K net profit on $572K gross revenue, with a clear three-month capital payback pathway and quarterly investor reporting.

cards.title: African Heritage, Global Standards
cards.description: Rooted in Tanzanian community employment, we maintain international best-practice safety and environmental standards across our Chunya site operations.

cards.title: Investor-First Governance
cards.description: Structured partnership agreements with defined equity positions, escrow protections, and monthly financial reporting to all strategic investors.

cards.title: Scientifically Verified Reserves
cards.description: Ground-truth surveys and geological assessments confirm viable, workable gold concentrations across our licensed acreage in the Lupa Goldfield basin.
